A) in-scope - implement and verify the 10k-row export under 60s.
B) deviates: omit the 10k-row/60s performance guarantee from this sprint.
C) deferred: move the performance requirement to a tracker ref or spec path you provide.
D) repair the ticket - run `/skill:shape-ticket acme/widgets#77` to revise the performance row to match the intended sprint scope.
Recommendation: D - align the ticket with your stated scope before continuing the design.
